in_sanskrit.name: समीरुल
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Samirul in Sanskrit can be derived from the words 'sam' meaning prosperity or wealth and 'irul' meaning rule or control. It suggests a person who has the ability to accumulate and manage wealth effectively.

in_hindi.name: समीरुल
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name Samirul in Hindi is derived from the words 'sam' meaning prosperity or wealth and 'irul' meaning rule or control. It is sometimes written as Samiranath and translates to 'God of Prosperity' or 'Lord of Wealth'.

in_tamil.name: சமிருல்
in_tamil.long_meaning: The name Samirul in Tamil can be derived from the words 'sam' meaning prosperity or wealth and 'irul' meaning rule or control. It translates to 'Mistress of Prosperity' or 'Lady of Wealth'.

in_telugu.name: శమీరుల్ళ
in_telugu.long_meaning: The name Samirul in Telugu is derived from the words 'sam' meaning prosperity or wealth and 'irul' meaning rule or control. It translates to 'God of Prosperity' or 'Lord of Wealth'.

in_marathi.name: Samirul
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Calm, Cool, Ruler
in_marathi.long_meaning: Samirul हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who has calm and cool mind, rules over his senses and emotions.

in_bengali.name: Samirul
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Calm, Cool, Ruler
in_bengali.long_meaning: Samirul একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। One who has calm and cool mind, rules over his senses and emotions.
